title: users
description: Household profiles (users.json). A top-level array of passwordless profiles used by the reader's profile picker and to namespace per-user annotations/positions (DESIGN §14, ADR-0005).

id.description: Stable profile id, used to namespace sync files ({user}/{book}). Slug-like.

name.description: Display name shown in the profile picker.

color.description: Avatar/accent color for this profile, as a CSS hex color (e.g. '#e07a5f').
